children: StubHub entered into Amendment No. 7 to its Credit Agreement to refinance and extend its senior credit facilities. The company upsized its USD Term Loan B to approximately $975 million, reduced its Euro Term Loan B to approximately €300 million, and extended both term loans to Oct 14, 2033. The Amended Credit Agreement also provides a $565 million revolving facility, with $140 million maturing Sep 30, 2030 and $425 million maturing Oct 14, 2031. Pricing includes SOFR or EURIBOR plus applicable margins, with potential step-downs tied to leverage, enhancing liquidity and flexibility.
: Amendment No. 7 to Credit Agreement covering term loans and revolving credit facility
: JPMorgan, J.P. Morgan SE and other lenders
: Term loans mature Oct 14 2033; revolver tranches mature Sep 30 2030 and Oct 14 2031
: Refinance, extend maturities, and optimize capital structure
